notes: Pass 1 only (CWE-022/023/036/073 Path Traversal); single pass block per task contract.
All 108 source-candidate and 85 sink-candidate rows from Phase 1 Step 2 were labeled (total 193); every row received exactly one decision (asserted programmatically), no row skipped or invented.

Deduplication: zero exact duplicate (file, line, callable, node-kind) pairs exist in either CSV; same-line pairs such as request.headers.get + request.headers attribute are distinct AST node shapes and were retained as separate entries. No entries were merged or dropped.

Exclusions: candidates labeled role=none/classification=fp with per-row exclusion basis (dev tools with literal paths, boolean env flags, headers with no path consumer, internal request-carrier params, DNS-resolve name collisions, example echo handlers). All exclusion rationales are recorded per entry in labels_raw_pass1.json.

Labeling performed in one session by glm-5.3 (the Claude Code CLI agent model; no external LLM API calls). 6 analysis batches over the real source: B1=Static-resource core (web_urldispatcher.py, web_fileresponse.py); B2=Request / multipart / wire input (web_request.py, multipart.py, http_parser.py, web_protocol.py); B3=Routing / middleware / response plumbing (web_app.py, web_middlewares.py, web_response.py, web_ws.py, web_log.py, web.py, web_runner.py); B4=Client-side file persistence (cookiejar.py, helpers.py, payload.py, connector.py); B5=Build & dev tooling (setup.py, tools/*, requirements/*); B6=Examples (examples/*). Batch membership and counts per batch are recorded in labels_raw_pass1.json.
matchKind is 'ast' (syntax-level) for every row; dynamic-dispatch ambiguity and receiver hints are documented in exploration/detection.json.

Key pass-1 finding recorded during labeling: the request-reachable static-file flow (raw_path -> _unquote_path -> match_info['filename'] -> Path -> joinpath -> resolve -> anchor guard + relative_to containment -> FileResponse stat/open/sendfile) is guarded by canonicalize-then-contain with follow_symlinks=False (default); residual risks (follow_symlinks=True opt-out, TOCTOU window between :645 and FileResponse re-stat/re-open, multipart filename reaching no in-tree path) are documented in labels/phase1_review.md.

Constraint compliance: no PyVul ground truth (VULNERABILITY_AUDIT_REPORT.md, path_traversal_sinks.csv), no patch diffs, no CVE advisories were consulted; source tree, CodeQL database, Augur installation and the Phase 1 CSVs were not modified.
